highlights: Portals installed before the 4.0 migration baseline can update again: the candidate proves bundled-migration coverage instead of requiring exact history equality.
HTTPS readiness probes every address Caddy actually listens on instead of assuming 127.0.0.1:443, which stalled updates and rollbacks for the full timeout.
A failed verification no longer stops a Portal that rollback had already restored and started.
A Caddy site customised by hand is adopted byte for byte instead of duplicated, so hosts with extra routes or headers no longer fail with 'ambiguous site definition'.
Withdraws 4.0.1 and 4.0.2, which were built from an incomplete source line and omitted code that shipped in 4.0.0.
